content_sections.heading: PUSSGRC Electrician Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the PUSSGRC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Electrician: Matric with two (02) years ITI Diploma in Electrician Trade from a recognized Institute.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 37 years. Relaxation in age for SC/ST candidates as per University rules.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PUSSGRC Electrician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Panjab University Swami Sarvanand Giri Regional Centre (PUSSGRC) for hiring eligible candidates on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being offered?
faq.answer: The post being offered in this recruitment drive is Electrician under the PUSSGRC organization.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Electrician position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in, and the selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by document verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q5. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the PUSSGRC Electrician recruitment is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026 at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Matric qualification along with a two (02) years ITI Diploma in Electrician Trade from a recognized Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 37 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the selected Electrician candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Electrician post will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 28,432/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at www.ssgpurch.puchd.ac.in or check the important links section provided in this recruitment article for complete information.
